environment.description: Same Quarkus native Lambda with Function URL. The function URL is configured with AuthType=AWS_IAM. The resource-based policy on the Lambda function specifies a Condition block requiring aws:PrincipalOrgID matching the organization ID (o-a1b2c3d4e5) and restricts lambda:InvokeFunctionUrl to principals within the org. There is no public-facing proxy or API Gateway in front. The function URL itself enforces SigV4 signature validation at the AWS infrastructure layer before the request reaches the Lambda runtime. Additionally, the AWS Organization has an SCP (ServiceControlPolicy) attached at the OU level that denies lambda:UpdateFunctionUrlConfig for all principals except the CI/CD role, preventing auth type downgrade. Note: the input validation bug in isValidTarget() remains present in the code.
